published_2026_reference.april: N5-level (NAT-TEST 5Q-level) Japanese. If a pass cannot be demonstrated: in principle approximately 400–500 study hours, exceeding 150 hours minimum.
published_2026_reference.october: JLPT N4 / NAT-TEST 4Q pass or equivalent ability. If N4-level certification cannot be demonstrated at application: generally 800–1,000 study hours, exceeding 550 hours minimum, AND JLPT N5 pass.
published_2026_reference.school_interview: School oral examination minimum score is required; numeric pass score not published.
published_2026_reference.study_certificate: Japanese-language institution certificate required at application regardless of exam certificate. Must describe learning period, hours and attendance.
published_2026_reference.test_note: Listed as acceptable proof documents in the 2026 guide; JLPT/NAT-TEST preferred. No universal equivalence scores supplied.

housing.minimum_residence_en: Residence in an affiliated dormitory is required in principle throughout enrollment. Six months is the initial payment period, not a stated minimum stay. The guide notes an exception for living with relatives in Osaka; confirm individual eligibility.
